run.title: Plan 04 — steme CLI: Commander and Usage Spec

commit.subject: refactor(steme): parse the CLI with Commander, preserving the exit contract
commit.body:
Replace the hand-rolled argv parser in apps/steme with a Commander program
exposing `steme audit <app-path> [--json]` plus --help/--version. The audit
pipeline is extracted unchanged into the audit command's action. exitOverride
maps help/version to exit 0 and every Commander parse error (unknown command or
option, missing argument) to EXIT_CANNOT_RUN (2), so a bad invocation never
masquerades as the "violations found" code (1). Existing smoke and E2E suites
stay green; two cases cover --help/--version exiting 0.

phases.title: Migrate the CLI to Commander, preserving the exit contract

commit.subject: feat(steme): emit a usage KDL spec via steme --usage
commit.body:
Add a hidden --usage meta flag that prints the usage KDL spec generated from the
Commander program (via @usage-spec/commander) and exits 0 without running an
audit, mirroring `phax --usage`. The Commander program remains the single source
of truth; the spec is a derived view. Covered by an E2E test asserting the spec
covers the audit command and --json option and runs no audit.

phases.title: Emit the usage KDL spec via `steme --usage`

commit.subject: feat(steme): generate and commit CLI completions and reference from the usage spec
commit.body:
Add a committed gen-cli-artifacts script that pipes `steme --usage` into the
usage binary to produce bash/zsh/fish completions and a markdown CLI reference,
all committed under apps/steme. A --check mode regenerates and diffs against the
committed files; a Vitest test runs it under pnpm test so stale artifacts fail
the full gate, keeping the derived files honest without a hand-maintained spec.
Requires the `usage` binary (added to phax agentCommands).

phases.title: Generate and commit completions + a markdown reference, staleness-gated
